The '''Symbia system''' was located in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the [[Symbian]] [[Language/Legends|language]].<ref name="MedStar">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=[[Symbian]]|system=Symbia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Symbia [[Star system/Legends|system]] was introduced in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square K-10.<ref name="TEA" />
